annotation.evidence_span: A proxy MAY transform the content of a message that does not contain a no-transform cache-control directive.
annotation.interpretation_a: The clause applies to all HTTP messages, so a proxy may transform either requests or responses that lack a no-transform directive.
annotation.interpretation_b: The clause applies only to responses, so a proxy may transform only responses that lack a no-transform directive, but not requests.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether the message is a request or a response, leading to two materially different implementation possibilities.
